# Fix brief (QA round 2). Do NOT edit src/data or research/. Use Impeccable skill; neutral, plain copy. Run pnpm build + pnpm validate until green. Don't commit/push.

1. Shared logic in src/lib/compare.ts (pure functions, unit-testable):
   - relation(user, cand): if user status no-opinion -> 'no-opinion'; user unanswered -> 'unanswered'; cand null -> 'unknown'; cand party-assumed && !includePartyAssumed -> 'assumed-excluded'. Else d=|u-c|: if (u===0) !== (c===0) && d<=2 -> 'partial' (middle vs a side, e.g. Moesinger 0 vs user -2 = partial); else if same sign or d<=1 -> 'agree'; else d>=2 -> 'differ'. Display thresholds legend in Compare: "Agree: same side or within one step. Partial: one of you is in the middle. Differ: two or more steps apart on opposite sides."
   - closeness per contest: for each candidate, over issues the user answered with importance>0 and stance not null: closeness=1-|u-c|/4, weight=importance. Score = sum(w*closeness)/sum(w). Exclude unknown and (unless toggle) party-assumed. coverage = counted/answeredRelevant. A candidate is "ranked" only if counted>=2 AND counted/answeredRelevant>=0.5; others shown as "Not enough info". Importance-0 answers excluded (explain in a small note). 
2. Compare page: per contest add a "Closest to your answers" section ordering candidates by score (ranked ones first, then "Not enough info"). Show a soft bar, not a percent-as-verdict, plus "Based on 3 of 5 issues you answered · 2 unknown". Expand -> per-issue trace: issue, your stance label, their stance label, relation, importance, weight contribution, evidence link. Neutral copy: "Closest match to your answers", never "vote for"/"winner". If user answered none for the contest, prompt to answer.
   Agree/differ counts must use relation() and be weighted ordering by importance. 
3. Everywhere (My Views charts, quiz slider, compare, mini charts) use the issue's real leftLabel/rightLabel at the ends. Remove '−2/+2', 'Option A/B', 'One viewpoint/Alternative viewpoint', 'Left/Right' generic labels. Stance labels: 'Strongly: <left>', 'Lean: <left>', 'Middle ground', 'Lean: <right>', 'Strongly: <right>'.
4. My Views chart: candidates at the same stop stack vertically (offset rows), YOU marker always rendered last/on top and visually distinct; no overlap at 390px.
5. Counts: My Views header and filter counts must use one source: show "X answered · Y no opinion · Z skipped of N". In Compare, no-opinion shows "No opinion" not "You haven't answered".
6. Compare contest selection must derive from the route param reactively (/compare/:contestId, useParams; /compare defaults to first contest). Clicking a contest navigates. No stale local state.
7. Party-assumed toggle: hide it in any view where zero party-assumed positions exist for the relevant candidates (currently none exist globally -> hidden), keep code.
